BunkerBroadcastBunkerSettings.description: BunkerBroadcastBunkerSettings controls bunker selection and access-code generation for each broadcast batch.

lockCodeLength.description: LockCodeLength is the number of digits in generated access codes. The game accepts values from 3 through 6.

lockCodeMode.description: LockCodeMode selects the access-code generation mode. The game accepts only 0 or 1.

numberOfActive.description: NumberOfActive is how many bunkers receive fresh codes in each batch. The game accepts values from 1 through 30.

BunkerBroadcastFile.description: BunkerBroadcastFile configures the bunker locations, broadcast schedule, access-code options, and Morse playback.

bunkerSettings.description: BunkerSettings sets how many bunkers participate in a broadcast batch and how their access codes are generated.

playbackSettings.description: PlaybackSettings controls Morse tone lengths, pauses, and repetitions.

proxies.description: Proxies are world-space positions associated with bunker broadcasts; each position contains X, Y, and Z coordinates.

schedulerSettings.description: SchedulerSettings controls batch lifetime, report cadence, and the in-game time windows when broadcasts may run.

BunkerBroadcastPeriod.description: BunkerBroadcastPeriod defines one allowed window on the in-game clock.

endTime.description: EndTime is the window end as four digits in HHMM form, such as `1930`.

startTime.description: StartTime is the window start as four digits in HHMM form, such as `0700`.

BunkerBroadcastPlaybackSettings.description: BunkerBroadcastPlaybackSettings controls the timing and repetition of Morse messages sent by bunker broadcasts.

bunkerRepetitions.description:
BunkerRepetitions is the number of additional times the current bunker's Morse broadcast is played
before playback moves to the next bunker.

dashDuration.description: DashDuration is the sound duration of one Morse dash, in seconds.

dotDuration.description: DotDuration is the sound duration of one Morse dot, in seconds.

messageRepetitions.description: MessageRepetitions is the number of additional times a message is repeated.

pauseBetweenBunkers.description: PauseBetweenBunkers is the pause before playback moves to the next bunker, in seconds.

symbolGapDuration.description: SymbolGapDuration is the pause between symbols within a Morse character, in seconds.

wordGapDuration.description: WordGapDuration is the pause between Morse words, in seconds.

BunkerBroadcastProxy.description: BunkerBroadcastProxy stores a world-space position where the game creates a proxy object for the bunker broadcast system.

position.description:
Position is the proxy's X, Y, and Z world coordinate.
The position should correspond to a bunker location that can be activated by the broadcast.

BunkerBroadcastSchedulerSettings.description: BunkerBroadcastSchedulerSettings configures when broadcasts are scheduled and how long each generated batch remains active.

batchLifetimeLength.description: BatchLifetimeLength is the batch lifetime in in-game minutes. Valid values are 1 through 1000.

periods.description:
Periods are in-game clock windows during which broadcasts may play.
The start and end use HHMM strings, and a window may continue past midnight.

reportInterval.description: ReportInterval is the scheduler report interval in in-game minutes. Valid values are 1 through 120.
